runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification; touching timestamps is not verification. Existing records keep their own verifiedAt unless their public detail was actually reopened or otherwise reconfirmed.
runSummary.note: Fresh 11.9.2026 17:40 sweep actually searched 11 source families: Profesia, direct-company careers, LinkedIn Jobs public index, Worki, Brigada.sk, Praca za rohom, Kariera/Zoznam, Pretlak/StartupJobs/WordPress Jobs, Upwork, Reddit/WordPress communities and public Facebook indexing. No new promotion-grade unique hit was confirmed. Grafton Office Manager in Bratislava (from 1750 EUR/month) is a good administrative fit but explicitly requires active English communication, so it remains below promotion threshold. Kariera also surfaced same-day Bratislava warehouse/administrative-adjacent results, but they were low-fit, physically demanding, low-pay or skill/language mismatches. Upwork produced multiple Worldwide VA/WordPress candidates, but the closest results failed on client trust, effective economics, strong-English/phone burden, country restriction, hard-development requirements or extreme workload. Facebook public indexing produced 0 concrete verifiable hiring posts.

developmentBacklogAdded.title: Front-desk speaking intensity classifier
developmentBacklogAdded.reason: Separate back-office administration from reception-heavy roles by extracting daily phone, visitor, supplier and meeting-contact intensity. This makes English A2/B1 risk and role fit more realistic for Office Manager and customer-facing admin jobs instead of treating all administration as equivalent.

developmentBacklogAdded.title: Role fragmentation / focus-cost score
developmentBacklogAdded.reason: Estimate how fragmented a role is across reception, calls, travel booking, office operations, HR support, reports and ad-hoc tasks. Use it as a secondary ranking signal so focused web/admin/support roles rank above highly interrupt-driven generalist roles when compensation and eligibility are otherwise similar.
